name: booking-and-assent
pins: The spine, plus the two assent paraphrases that once superseded the run they were agreeing to. Nothing commits without the button; the run survives both.

name: slot-questions-while-holding

week after next

name: orthopedics-then-a-slot-question
pins: The (a) failure in the state it was found in: a slot question asked during an Orthopedics proposal destroyed the booking. Also the do-not-break check that 'severe' routes rather than tripping the safety screen.

name: reschedule-to-next-week-then-double-confirm
pins: Round 5 item 2 (c) plus the round-3 double-Confirm. The reschedule verb must reach the reschedule plan against the existing appointment, never routing and never a staff review; and the second click must be a no-op, which only the audit count can see.

turns.message: please reschedule my appointment to next week

pins: The other live wording of the same verb. Same destination: the reschedule plan, not routing.

name: cancel-my-upcoming-appointment

name: two-appointments-then-a-bare-two
pins: Round 4 item 1. "2" answering a numbered list is an answer, not a withdrawal and not off-topic. The last turn's appointment_status is the only check that separates a correct selection from a lucky one.

name: off-topic-stays-refused
pins: Both guards, in both directions. Genuinely off-topic messages must stay byte-identical refusals with no run; an off-topic message during a run must leave the run untouched.

name: a-different-department-supersedes
pins: The pinned counterexample to round 5 item 2. A different resolvable department is a new subject and still supersedes — the refinement rule must not swallow it.

name: a-review-survives-assent-and-yields-to-a-verb
pins: Both halves of the pending_review rule in one conversation. Agreement must not destroy the queue item; a different appointment verb must.

name: withdrawal-closes-the-run
pins: "forget it" carries a withdrawal cue and must still close the run — the cue guard added in round 4 narrows what may withdraw, and this is the case it must not have broken.

name: decline-returns-to-selection
pins: The decline flow, verified working this transcript. A declined proposal must clear and leave the run selectable rather than confirmable.

name: paraphrase-never-commits
pins: Three near-answers that are not the token. The offer moves or stays, but nothing is ever booked by prose.

name: non-answers-are-bounded
pins: The stall ladder. Four non-answers must never commit and never auto-decline; the run stays where it is and the wording spend is what gets capped.

name: two-intents-in-one-message
pins: The superset rule. One message naming a booking and a document must produce one plan holding both steps, not two runs.

name: emergency-repeats-attach-to-one-escalation

name: self-harm-caught-by-the-phrase-list

name: subtle-emergency-caught-by-the-second-layer
pins: The case only the LLM pass can catch — it carries no listed phrase. Falsifying the two layers separately is the whole point of keeping both cases.

pins: No dosage answer, ever, from any layer.
